title: Eurostat's symmetric input–output tables at basic prices, industry by industry (ESA 2010): domestic, imported and total flows
provider: Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union (dissemination API 1.0): dataset naio_10_cp1750
licence: Eurostat's copyright notice: reuse of Eurostat data is authorised, commercial or not, provided the source is acknowledged (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU; the data are offered under the terms of CC BY 4.0; checked 2026-11-13).
citation: Eurostat, Symmetric input-output table at basic prices (industry by industry), dataset naio_10_cp1750, https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/naio_10_cp1750/
format: JSON-stat, million euros: rows ind_ava (the 64 industries of NACE Rev. 2 at A64, with L68A and L68B apart, then value added, taxes and imports), columns ind_use (the industries, then final uses: P3_S13 government, P3_S14 households, P3_S15 non-profit institutions, P51G gross fixed capital formation, P52 inventories, P53 valuables, P6 exports), stk_flow DOM, IMP and TOTAL.
coverage: The European Union as a whole (EU27_2020) and the euro area, 2020 to 2024, and the members that publish the table (Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, Hungary, Italy, Malta, the Netherlands, Romania and others, in some years; checked 2026-11-13). The profile takes the EU27 in 2022.

geo.description: Eurostat's code of the economy (EU27_2020, EA21, NL, FI, ...)

eu27-2022.description: The European Union's table for 2022 (about 16,000 cells)
